free_tier.stated: 3 Pod-hours free, once, with no card; 1 Pod at a time with the Latest Xcode, Simulators and the build queue included, and no extra hours: a plan must be picked when the hours run out

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a macOS Pod, not an object

retention.stated: a Pod is destroyed ten minutes after its last session with its repository clone, build products, caches and injected secrets; a rescue branch with uncommitted changes is pushed to the customer's git host, and dashboard logs and screenshots are kept for 30 days in the chosen region

egress.terms: no published egress allowance or price: Pods are outbound only to api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, the git host and package registries, with no inbound ports, no SSH and no screen sharing

interface_detail: sessions start from claude.ai, Claude Desktop, Slack or the Codex app; the agent runs inside the Pod and pushes a branch and pull request; there is no SSH, VNC or screen sharing
tooling: a Claude Team or Enterprise self-hosted environment key, or an OpenAI Agents API webhook registered as a sandbox webhook; the Pods carry Claude Code, Codex, Xcode, iOS Simulators and XcodeBuildMCP
chaining: a Pod is a macOS VM for one developer's Claude Code or Codex agents that need Xcode and pre-booted iOS Simulators; model tokens bill to the customer's own Anthropic or OpenAI account, so the free 3 Pod-hours buy only Mac time and do not cover inference. A hosted offer, not a self-hosted one: the user runs no server binary.

limits.value: 3 Pod-hours once on Free, then no extra hours: 1 Pod at a time, metered per second while a Pod runs including the ten minutes after its last session
a Pod stops 10 minutes after its last session, and sessions run for at most 8 hours before the agent is asked to wrap up and push

limits_note: the 10-minute tail is billed; Free has no extra hours at any price, and a plan must be chosen when the 3 included hours run out. Pro is USD 99/month for 300 Pod-hours then USD 0.40/extra Pod-hour; Team is USD 399/month for 1,500 Pod-hours then USD 0.30/extra Pod-hour.
binding_note: the one-time 3 Pod-hours and the 1-Pod-at-a-time cap run out first on Free, and the 10-minute tail after a session ends is billed against them.

identity_cost.detail: the sign-in page offers Continue with Google, Continue with GitHub, or a work email address with a sign-in link; no card is needed for Free

reliability_note: Pods are destroyed 10 minutes after a session ends and are never reused across customers; uncommitted work is saved to a rescue branch, while build caches and injected secrets are destroyed with the Pod. No uptime guarantee is published.
confidence_note: prices, free grant, Pod limits and metering are quoted from the vendor's own pricing page and home page read on 2026-11-25; the signup and identity gate are quoted from the vendor's sign-in page.

notes: A hosted macOS Pod for Claude Code and Codex agents that need Xcode and iOS Simulators, with 3 free Pod-hours once and no card. The listed USD 0.30/hour is the Team plan's extra-Pod-hour rate (USD 399/month for 1,500 hours, then USD 0.30); Pro's extra rate is USD 0.40/hour and USD 99/month buys 300 hours. The 10-minute tail after a session ends is billed, and the Pod has no SSH and no inbound ports. The model is billed separately by Anthropic or OpenAI. Not self-hosted: Macswarm operates the Macs.
